metadata.author: Lexi Blackburn

cross_category_inference.snapshot: directCap0 — immutable pre-proxy direct capability composites (no proxy-to-proxy recursion)
cross_category_inference.admissibility_filter: directCap0 excludes null/non-finite scores and thinBasis pairings (neutralized single-observation / one-row / non-ranking); pre-snapshot upward effort-interpolation and version-promotion remain eligible and carry status
cross_category_inference.disconnected_components: cross-scaffold agentic_execution ordering is non-semantic; no measured cross-component bridge is invented — architecture/security_review/mechanical fills from it are inferred_low only
cross_category_inference.weighting: equal weight over AVAILABLE parents (renormalized); a missing parent receives no synthetic value
cross_category_inference.availability_rule: parent capability composite score !== null and finite (a normalized 0 is valid low evidence)
cross_category_inference.confidence_policy: every filled row labeled inferred_low (uncalibrated); coverage recorded for later calibration
cross_category_inference.applied_stage: after direct parent perfScores finalized (interpolation + SOP-1 + monotonicity); before DATA_MISSING gate and composites
cross_category_inference.cost_policy: cost excluded from the proxy; applied exactly once downstream via rankBranch/powerScore
cross_category_inference.direct_precedence: only null direct cells filled; a real direct score always wins
cross_category_inference.reinterpolation: none — synthesized branches are not re-interpolated or re-promoted (no downward inference)
cross_category_inference.version_promotion_policy: disabled_under_opt_in: cross-model SOP-1 version-promotion is not applied to any category before base/proxy composition; proxy anchors are same-model measured or upward-effort-interpolated only (no unsupported cross-model copy; no thin predecessor promoted forward to bypass the admissibility filter)
cross_category_inference.opt_in: dataset.proxy_synthesis.enabled === true (required; no synthesis and no gap-gate change without it)

coverage_gate.method: measured-only floor by default; under opt-in + owner authorization the SAME 0.30 minimum is applied to signal coverage (measured + audited inferred, counted apart)

producers_excluded: 394fc5ed-4b73-4d1a-af09-01f888540979 (pass-2 critic, authoritative launch id; on-disk receipt erroneously records 7c3e9f21 pending correction)

inter_judge_dissent.variance_status: not quantified per category in frozen core

frozen_core_judge_reconciliation.judge_B: FINISHED_FAILED 18:55 (API error: output exceeded 32000 tokens). No accepted B judgment. Partial B files QUARANTINED, not inherited. Not retried (owner: 3 completed judges sufficient).
frozen_core_judge_reconciliation.quorum: 3 completed independent judges + fresh independent merger gate preserved ('all' = all COMPLETED judgments; optional extra B not unboundedly awaited).
frozen_core_judge_reconciliation.base_choice: Judge D final adopted as canonical merge base: it is builder-faithful (matches build_routing_table.mjs cost formula, ratio-to-max cost_norm, min-max within-group capability, fallback 89, full 1329 completeness).
agreements: C corroborates all counts and category dispositions after C's cost table is corrected 1.35->1.30 (x0.962963); C computed no full branch scores, no conflict.
A corroborates: coding<-agentic_execution, tokenizer 1.30, TB4 cross-scaffold nonsemantic, thin_coverage, owner opt-in, cost-normalization divergence flagged.

divergences_resolved_by_authority_not_av.resolution: REJECT A's blend; use builder-faithful min-max WITHIN group + equal-weight across groups (D): opus-5-5@high appears only in MathArena gap_fill (top -> 1.0). Canonical cap_norm=1.0. build_routing_table.mjs capability_formula is authority; not averaged.

divergences_resolved_by_authority_not_av.a_value: A treats the single opus-4-5-20251101@medium SWE row as DIRECT best (ranked)
divergences_resolved_by_authority_not_av.resolution: REJECT. A single-row noncomparative anchor cannot be a ranked direct signal (prior review prohibits noncomparative neutral entering the profile; thin-rule; C/D + primary-group facts agree). Singleton preserved as raw-score CONTEXT ONLY (not ranked). debugging fills from ORIGINAL agentic_execution in BOTH branches (inferred_low); direct-wins reserved so any future legit comparative supersedes.
REJECT. Current builder authority wins: fallback_default has 89 real pairings (direct-mean of math_proof+agentic_execution; existing precedence-99 algorithm). D matches (89). Not sentinel-only.

adversarial_passes.reconciliation_note: Frozen core judge_reconciliation is preserved verbatim in inter_judge_dissent.frozen_core_judge_reconciliation. Critic PASS results do not imply zero ranking-judge variance.

performance_cost_winsorization.note: Performance-branch only: per-pairing $/token clipped to the [p05,p95] universe window before cost_norm (renormalized by the winsorized max), so an extreme price ratio cannot swing the capability-dominant score (~R^0.2). cost_efficiency uses the raw cost_norm.

metadata.cost_figure_methodology: SOP-2 worst-case $/token: constant 100K-in / 20K-visible-out blend, opus tokenizer inflation 1.35x (1.4x deprecated), effort hidden-output multiplier ladder, gpt-5.5 272K cliff sub-cliff at this blend. cost_norm = $/token / universe-max in (0,1]. Branch score = perf_norm^a / cost_norm^b. Refinement #6: the PERFORMANCE branch winsorizes $/token to the [p05,p95] universe window before cost_norm (see performance_cost_winsorization) so an extreme price ratio cannot swing the capability-dominant score; cost_efficiency uses the raw cost_norm.

formula_definitions.performance_branch_tiebreak: same-model equal measured perf_norm → effort descending (max-effort first) before cost can discriminate. Cost separates only across models on the performance branch. (#1 fix)

above_cliff_cost_figure.note: above-cliff rate at reference blend (100K in / 20K out), hiddenMult=0 excluded; for G_CTX_272 routes only
